subject: POC sign-off matrix and contract cadence: next steps
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@cornerstone.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC sign-off matrix and contract cadence: next steps

Hi Emma — thanks again for your time on the demo today. Quick recap and proposed routing so we can keep timelines tight for the POC.

Key stakeholders we captured (please confirm if I missed anyone):
- Economic sponsor: Sarah Lin, VP Product (final sign-off on POC acceptance & budget)
- Procurement / Legal: Tom Burke (procurement lead, legal owns redlines)
- InfoSec: Angela Park (security questionnaire + SOC2 verifier) — noted she may delegate to a vendor risk team
- Technical champion: Emma Johnson (day-to-day POC coordination)

Contract routing proposal (recommended sequence and rationale):
1) NDA (mutual) — get this signed first so we can exchange full security docs and SOW.
   - Owners: Cornerstone legal + Redwood legal (I can send our mutual NDA template now).
   - Expected turnaround: ~1–2 business days once signatures are routed.
2) Security package & vendor questionnaire — to satisfy InfoSec gating for POC infra access.
   - Owners: Redwood SE (Maya) to provide SOC2 summary and questionnaire responses.
   - Expected turnaround: 1–3 business days for the summary, 3–5 for detailed questionnaire completion.
3) MSA + DPA (concurrent with procurement PO) — legal redlines on MSA/DPA often take longest; we suggest starting redlines while procurement prepares the PO.
   - Owners: Cornerstone legal / procurement and Redwood legal.
   - Expected turnaround: 7–10 business days typical for initial redline loop; accelerated options available for POC.
4) PO & SOW sign-off — finalize pricing band and acceptance criteria in SOW so implementation can start immediately after signatures.
   - Owners: Cornerstone procurement & finance; Redwood AE / Solutions to provide SOW.

Asks / next steps:
- Emma: please confirm the official signer for the NDA (name & email) and whether Cornerstone prefers DocuSign or internal procurement portal.
- Tom (if you prefer me to loop procurement directly, please confirm contact) — we're aiming to start the POC by 2026-08-17 if the above can move on the timeline above.
- Maya: can you prepare the SOC2 summary + the vendor questionnaire template we filled previously? If we can attach those to the NDA packet that will speed InfoSec review.

Attachments: RINF_NDA_template_v1.pdf (attached stub), draft SOW placeholder (we'll replace after requirements).

Tentative timeline if everything moves as above: NDA signed by 2026-08-05, security package complete by 2026-08-09, MSA redline loop completed ~2026-08-20, PO & SOW signed shortly after.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rafael — great recap and aligns with how procurement usually routes. Quick confirmations and a few asks from our side: 

1) NDA signer: I'll route to Tom Burke (tom.burke@cornerstone.com) for legal review; procurement prefers DocuSign for external NDAs.
2) Security: Angela Park asked for a vendor security questionnaire + SOC2 Type II report or summary. Can you provide a one-pager SOC2 summary and the questionnaire responses we can share with vendor risk?

Forwarding procurement note for visibility — Tom, Sarah: Rafael will send the NDA and SOC2 summary; Maya is looped for the questionnaire.

Onward — Emma
